subject: Q3 renewal - usage health + token efficiency playbook
messages:
From: Sarah Yang <sarah@orbit.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@orbit.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T09:02:00Z
Subject: Q3 renewal - can we run a quick usage health review?

Hi Laura,

Our Q3 renewal is coming up next month and the finance team wants a short health + ROI recap before we sign. We had a few unexpected spikes in token spend in April (see attached exported billing), and the product team also reported some latency regressions on longer chat sessions last week.

Can we schedule a 30-min review next week to walk through:
- Token consumption trends by model and route (chat vs. embeddings)
- Any recent runtime changes that could explain latency
- Quick ideas for immediate token savings (batching, cache suggestions)
- Renewal options and pricing impact if we scale capacity +10-30%

Attaching our internal usage snapshot (OrbitAI_Q3_usage_report.pdf). Happy to include our Head of Finance on the call: finance@orbit.ai.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Yang
Director of Product
OrbitAI

[Attachment: OrbitAI_Q3_usage_report.pdf]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T11:10:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Q3 renewal - can we run a quick usage health review?

Forwarding Orbit's note — they want a concise health + ROI recap before renewal. Key asks: token trends, latency explanation, immediate savings, and pricing scenarios.

Marcus: can you pull the last 90 days by model + route and isolate any spikes (timestamps are in the attachment)? Also include percent of requests that hit cache vs full forward pass.

Stephanie: can you draft 1-page playbook with 3 quick levers (batching thresholds, prefix caching, recommended quantization profile) and a 2-line estimate of $/1k token delta if they adopt each? Put it into token_efficiency_playbook_v1.docx and link it back.

I'll own the renewal scenarios and customer call. Looking to land a recommended baseline: +10% capacity with a conditional discount for committing to a 12-month reserved pool.

Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-15T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Q3 renewal - can we run a quick usage health review?

Laura / Steph — I pulled the telemetry and billing slices. High-level notes (short):
- Spike on 2027-04-18 to 04-21 correlates with a deploy that bumped model variant from redwood/gpt-medium:fp16 -> redwood/gpt-medium:bfloat16-optimized for latency; unfortunately, that variant disables an older prefix cache we relied on which increased token processing by ~22% for long-context chat sessions.
- Embeddings route is steady; chat route (app-chat) accounts for 72% of token spend.
- Cache hit rate dropped from 41% -> 16% for sessions > 1k tokens after that deploy.

Attachments: condensed CSV slices and a short timeline (attached).

Immediate remediation steps (can be executed in 48-72 hours):
1) Re-enable prefix cache for the medium model for requests with session length > 256. Estimated reduction: ~15% token spend.
2) Apply per-route batching at 100ms window for chat to improve throughput when concurrency > 50; estimated saving: ~8% token cost and ~12% latency median improvement.
3) Recommend a quantized variant for embeddings/low-risk routes to shave cost on non-chat workload; estimated cost delta in playbook.

I'll hand the CSV and timeline to Steph for the playbook numbers.

[Attachment: telemetry_slices_2027-04.csv]

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Yang <sarah@orbit.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-18T15:40:00Z
Subject: RE: Q3 renewal - usage health + token efficiency playbook

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the report. We ran the analysis and put together a short playbook attached. TL;DR: we recommend a staged approach so you get immediate cost relief and preserve end-user latency/quality.

Playbook summary (attached: token_efficiency_playbook_v1.docx):
- Short-term (48–72h): Re-enable prefix cache for long sessions + per-route 100ms batching. Expected token spend reduction: ~20% (combined), with median latency improvement ~10–15ms for chat.
- Medium-term (2–4 weeks): Migrate non-critical embeddings traffic to a quantized variant (INT8). Expected cost delta: -30% on embeddings spend.
- Renewal offer: Recommend 12-month reserved pool with +10% baseline capacity and a 12% committed discount. If OrbitAI agrees to a 24-month commit we can extend to an 18% discount and include one free optimization sprint.

Estimated financial impact: current monthly token bill ~$48,500. Short-term changes target ~$9–10k/mo savings. With the 12-month commit and the operational savings we project ~20–25% effective unit-cost reduction in year one. Full breakdown in the attached doc.

Next steps:
1) Laura: book a 30-min review with Sarah and Orbit finance (they suggested Tue 5/25 or Wed 5/26).
2) Marcus/Eng: ready to schedule the quick cache/batching rollout for a Friday maintenance window (48–72h).
3) Orbit: confirm preferred commitment horizon (12 vs 24m).

Thanks — attaching the playbook and the telemetry extract we used.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachments: token_efficiency_playbook_v1.docx, telemetry_slices_2027-04.csv]
